resources.string: Khotwa AI is a voice assistant: it reads the names of buttons and fields visible on screen so it can place a small circle on the button you are looking for and explain the steps out loud. It never reads password fields or what you type, and it never taps or sends anything for you.
Your smart guide on any screen. Tell it what you want to do, and it shows you the way step by step, by voice.
Built-in AI that works instantly, no keys and no setup
Talk naturally and it answers you by voice
A small circle points to the exact button to tap
Never reads passwords and never taps for you
By continuing you agree that Khotwa reads button names on screen only while you ask for help. Passwords, banking apps and field contents are never read.
Setup is not complete. Tap to enable on-screen guidance.
Ask anything, or tell me a task and I will guide you on your screen.
How do I apply for a scholarship online?
Help me fill out a government form
How do I make my phone text bigger?
Write a short professional email for me
So I can hear you while guiding you on the screen.
Enable Khotwa in Accessibility so I can see button names and point to them. I never read passwords.

I will go with you on the screen, speak each step and point to the right button.
Your chats are saved on this phone only
Built-in, free and fast. Works right away with no key or account, with automatic backup engines.
Runs inside your phone: private, works offline and understands images on supported phones.

Not required. If you have a Gemini, OpenAI, Claude or Groq key, Khotwa will use it first for extra power and image understanding. A Google AI Studio key is free.
Unknown key. It should start with AQ. / AIza (Gemini), gsk_ (Groq), sk-ant- (Claude) or sk- (OpenAI).
The key works but its quota is used up right now.
The key does not have access to this model.
Key removed. Khotwa Cloud will be used.

The screenshot is sent only when you ask, and never inside banking, wallet or authentication apps.
Needs on-device AI or your own key.
Khotwa reads button and field names only while you ask for help.
It never reads passwords or what you type in fields.
Banking, wallet and authentication apps are fully excluded.
It never taps, types or sends anything on your behalf.
Your chats are stored on your phone only.
Questions are sent to the AI engine to get a reply, without your name or account.
Say stop or tap the button at any time to end guidance.
Press start, then open any app within 6 seconds.
Delete all chats on this phone?
Without the microphone I cannot hear you during guidance. Open Settings > Permissions > Microphone > Allow.

I am Khotwa. Tell me what you want to get done, like applying for a scholarship, filling a form or changing a phone setting, and I will guide you on your screen by voice and place a small circle on the button to tap. You can also ask me anything here.
To guide you on the screen I only need these permissions. Tap them here:

The next step is “%1$s”. Tap it and I will continue with you.

I am Khotwa. Write what you want to get done and I will plan it with you step by step.

Got it. Open the app or page you need, then start guidance and I will point to one step at a time.
